title: Wiki Cat (WKC) 📈 24.8%

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Wiki Cat's valuation ignores the lack of real-world adoption and relies on hype, not tangible utility.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The recent protocol upgrades and cross-chain integrations are driving real demand and justifying the rally.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Those upgrades are speculative. Wiki Cat still lacks a scalable consensus mechanism and has poor transaction throughput.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Scalability is improving with the new sharding model, and DeFi use cases are now live on the mainnet.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This rally is the result of actual technical progress, not just speculation — the future is here.

caption_text: Wiki Cat is overvalued vs Wiki Cat rally is justified
